decisions.reason: As an adjacent extension of an established sports-flooring capability, it can be retained if results are near aspiration and industry growth provides enough slack, even though it is not central to the firm's style-led direction.

This specialized mobile arena system is farther from the firm's main residential-design trajectory, so if its early results have fallen short of aspiration management is likely to reallocate resources to stronger core lines or other developments.

Because it overlaps with another mobile arena offering and serves a narrow niche, a boundedly rational management would likely prune it when comparing its payoff with aspirations and alternative uses of resources.
This flagship chevron parquet line fits the firm's stated future direction in premium, trend-led natural flooring, so it is likely to stay unless performance is clearly well below aspiration.
The squash-court surface finish is a narrow specialist product outside the firm's main growth narrative, making it a likely candidate for exit if its sales have not justified continued attention.
As a low-complexity accessory that complements existing sports-floor installations, it can be kept with modest resource commitment while management concentrates larger bets elsewhere.
